faqs.question: What is Top10Lists.us?

by_question.Do Top10Lists badges expire?: Badges do not expire on a fixed date but become invalid if you drop below the 4.5+ merit criteria, your license lapses, or you cancel a paid tier subscription. Refresh frequency varies by tier (annual/quarterly/monthly/daily) but the badge itself remains active continuously.
